verdicts.reason: Both turn the dark header band into a large empty dark block in the top-left, with the Q logo shrunk to an unreadable speck, so the brand is effectively lost. The headline is squeezed into a narrow right column, and the body copy, CTA and legal text are packed into the bottom with almost no margins. A at least keeps the 'Reserve a Case' button large enough to stand out, though it drops the orange divider. In B the CTA is tiny and gets lost, which weakens the hierarchy more.
